summary: Regression verification after fix removing external CDN icon-font fetch (@expo/vector-icons via cdn.jsdelivr.net) from app/_layout.tsx and adding a 2.5s failsafe timeout so SplashScreen.hideAsync() always fires. Confirmed via grep no remaining references to use-icon-fonts / jsdelivr / StoreClient anywhere in frontend/app or frontend/src. Backend: full pytest suite (15/15) passes - health, boundaries, PFZ, 5 chat flows (flagship UNSAFE verdict, PFZ intent, Telugu, chlorophyll/SST dual-chart, alerts query), persistence, rate limiting, alerts (2 active hazards), notifications, geofence breach true/false, locations CRUD. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844) smoke test via Playwright: app boots cleanly to Chat tab with no red screen/hang; radar card + 4 quick-prompt suggestions render; tapped suggestion-0 -> full agentic pipeline responded with UNSAFE-style advisory text, inline MAP widget block (expected WebView-unsupported-on-web message), SOURCES list (5 mock sources), and collapsible REASONING TRACE (7 agents); Alerts tab loaded ACTIVE HAZARDS (cyclone + lightning) and NOTIFICATIONS via GET /api/alerts; Saved tab: opened add-location modal, saved TEST_UI_Geofence_Spot at 16.96/82.31 via POST /api/locations (toast 'Location saved'), card rendered, tapped GEOFENCE action -> POST /api/geofence/check returned breach:true -> auto-navigated to Alerts tab showing new 'Geofence breach: Kakinada Deep-Water Port Restricted Zone' notification referencing the saved location by name. Tab navigation Chat<->Alerts<->Saved smooth with no flicker or crash. No console errors besides expected dev-only React DevTools/useNativeDriver warnings. Test location cleaned up via DELETE /api/locations/{id} after test.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx fix verified correct: ready = fontsLoaded || !!fontError || timedOut with FAILSAFE_MS=2500 guarantees SplashScreen.hideAsync() is always eventually called regardless of font/network state. No remaining CDN dependency (grep confirmed zero hits for use-icon-fonts/jsdelivr/StoreClient in frontend/app and frontend/src).
Local SpaceMono font load is bundled (require) so it should resolve near-instantly in Expo Go too, making the failsafe a true backstop rather than the primary path - good defensive design.

Previously flagged minor issues from iteration_1 (dead soft-delete code, in-memory rate limiter single-worker assumption, agents.py keyword precedence) remain unaddressed but are non-blocking and unrelated to this fix.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 TEST_UI_Geofence_Spot location via UI + DELETE /api/locations/{id} verified removed via GET.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Expo Go boot-hang bug fix is verified sound via code review (no CDN calls left, failsafe timeout in place) and via web preview smoke test (which never exercised the buggy StoreClient-only path anyway, but confirms no other regression was introduced). Actual native Expo Go device/QR verification was not performed by this agent (no device access in this environment) - if strict verification of native Expo Go boot is required, main agent or user should scan QR and confirm splash hides within ~2.5s on a real device/simulator. All backend and web-preview frontend flows pass with no issues.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no new bugs found.
